walk.environment: Fixed build: read-only worktree /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/tree @ 0deff9c4, never modified. Server launched from that folder with the repo venv (/home/user/Open-Omniscience/.venv/bin/python -c 'from src.api.main import main; main()'), proxy vars unset, OO_DB_PASSPHRASE and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT both UNSET at boot; port 8909; data dir /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/L/data (fresh, not copied). Seeding: scripts/ui_clickthrough_seed.py default (STATE C, 453 articles) with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE='walk-pass-2026', then the row-L supplementary seed_extra.py (copied from /tmp/claude-0/walk/L) with the server stopped and the same passphrase. It adds SYNTHETIC World Bank figures (NY.GDP.MKTP.CD / SP.POP.TOTL / SP.DYN.LE00.IN, 250 stored each, 44 countries incl. XKX + WB aggregates), 6 USGS rare-earth rows, index series, law revisions (GBR/EUU/FRA changes) and Wikipedia changes. AT REST: both open_omniscience.db and wiki.db start with non-'SQLite format 3' bytes (ciphertext). /api/system/lock-state read 'locked' before unlock and 'unlocked-encrypted' after; the unlock went through the real #pw / #btn-unlock form in every session. NETWORK: airplane mode throughout (/api/system/network online:false; plane glyph filled). Consent popups opened: 'Load standard country data' in en/fr/ar/zh plus the lane-disclosure check. Each was read, screenshotted and cancelled; 'Go online' was never pressed; zero non-loopback requests recorded by the browser. Browser: Playwright Chromium /opt/pw-browsers/chromium, headless, args --disable-background-networking --disable-component-update --no-proxy-server. Viewports: 1440x950 in en/fr/ar/zh and 375x800 in en. Differences from the first walk: Governments (L11) and Markets (L10) use synthetic data, not a real online-collected install. The Re-seed toast was captured on a second press ('Seeded 0 sources, 0 laws.'), because the boot autoseed had already seeded the catalogue (27 law docs before and after). Server stopped by PID (kill 445). Evidence: screenshots in /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/L/shots (128 PNGs), per-script results in /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/L/res-*.json, exported CSV at /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/L/open-omniscience-sources.csv, bulletin text at /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/L/bulletin-doc.txt.

new_defects.title: Home 'Source laundering' Lead card: title, summary, type label and caveat stay English in fr/ar/zh
new_defects.repro: On the encrypted seed, switch to Français (or العربية / 中文), open Home, find the 'SOURCE LAUNDERING' card ('3 sources, one origin: wire-agency.example') and flip it to its back.
new_defects.expected: The title, summary, type label and the visible caveat are in the chosen language, like the neighbouring law card ('Loi modifiée (FRA) : …'). The informed-consent non-negotiable requires every caveat string in 12 locales.
new_defects.actual: In fr, ar and zh the card reads 'SOURCE LAUNDERING', '3 sources, one origin: wire-agency.example' and '3 articles from 3 distinct sources (…) all cite the same origin — apparent corroboration that traces to ONE source…'. Its back caveat 'Several sources citing the same single origin are NOT independent corroboration — one source wearing many hats. … read the origin yourself.' is also English. Only the 'Détails et corpus' chrome is translated.
new_defects.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/L/res-home2-fr.json (full card text); res-home-ar.json and res-home-zh.json (same English nodes in ar/zh); shot /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/L/shots/home-laundering-card-fr.png
new_defects.root_cause_lead: src/briefing/producers.py:2084-2092 builds the title and summary as English f-strings with no title_i18n/summary_i18n and no vars, unlike the law card's pattern. caveat=LAUNDERING_CAVEAT (src/analytics/laundering.py:32) has no locale key anywhere under src/static (grep of 'one source wearing many hats' finds nothing).

new_defects.title: A live language switch leaves several row-L country and language hovers and lists in the previous language until reload
new_defects.repro: Boot in en and visit Agenda (Country dropdown), Insights > Map ('By country'), an Insights concept map, World map > Coverage (click Germany), Governments > Countries (picker), Governments > Statistics level map, Settings > Advanced > Sources (Producers table) and Advanced > Calendar directory. Switch the top-bar language to Français without reloading, then re-read and hover each.
new_defects.expected: Every name follows the switch, as World coverage (L6), Living sources, Minerals supply, Governments > Law and the Sources table already do.
new_defects.actual: These stay English after the switch: the Agenda country options and their order ('🇦🇷 Argentina (ARG)', '🇦🇺 Australia (AUS)'); the Insights BRA hover 'Brazil'; concept-map hovers SAU 'Saudi Arabia', ara 'Arabic' and the tail '— mentions per language'; the World map detail heading DEU hover 'Germany' (the rest of the panel is French); the Governments country picker 'Albania (ALB)', 'Algeria (DZA)'; the statistics-map WLD hover 'World — published aggregate'; the Producers RUS hover 'Russia'; and the calendar-directory status '… 241 not checked yet'. All are correct after a reload (L13).
new_defects.root_cause_lead: These renderers are not registered in app-boot.js's single oo:langchange listener (src/static/app-boot.js:41 ff.). It repaints renderAgenda (list), repaintGovViewsFromCache, repaintStatTablesFromCache, loadManagedSources, loadMineralsSupply and loadLawDocs. It does not repaint the #agenda-country option builder, the Insights #map-countries table, the concept map, the #oo-coverage-detail heading (app-map.js), the Governments country <select>s, renderStatMap (app-map.js:2471), the Producers table, or the feed-directory status line (app-agenda.js:774).

walk.summary:
Row L re-walk on the fixed build 0deff9c4. The store was encrypted and locked at boot and unlocked through #pw/#btn-unlock; airplane mode held throughout and every consent popup was cancelled. All 13 row steps pass, plus the 375 px pass. L10 and L11 used synthetic World Bank, USGS and index data, so their real-install clause is not measurable. In L7 no shape is drawn as a point on this corpus, so the dot-tooltip sub-check is not observable.

All 17 confirmed row-L defects are fixed. Examples: VAT, AIA and COK resolve; Insights by-country, Minerals Area and the World map detail heading all have hovers; the Worldview and country pickers sort by the localised name; the consent popup names its action; XKX and the aggregates are disclosed.

These cross-row defects are also fixed:
- M6: the Bulletin is a top-level fold.
- U3: the directory hint is corrected.
- H1/O5/P1: the in-dialog bubble is visible above the consent modal.
- H2: lane names take focus.
- P9: Settings > Wikipedia has no horizontal scroll at 375 px.
- T7/O2: the coach has no overlap in ar or en.

Nine new defects:
- P2: the Home 'Source laundering' Lead card, including its caveat, is English in fr/ar/zh.
- P3: a live language switch leaves several row-L hovers and lists stale until reload (Agenda country list, Insights by-country, concept map, World map detail heading, Governments picker, statistics-map aggregates, Producers, calendar status).
- P3: Minerals supply caveat, measures and units are English, and the caveat shows 'A None value'.
- P3: the statistics level-map note is English and aggregate names stay English in hovers.
- P3: World map Stories has English months, '≈ country' and 'Official / reference source ↗'.
- P3: the Law panel keeps 'bytes', 'open reader', 'reader · official ↗' and raw 'legislation' / 'large-removal'.
- P3: the Sources pager 'page 1 of 129' and the calendar status 'N feeds · N folders · N checked' are untranslated.
- P3: the World coverage 'THIN (<3)' tile is untranslated.
- P3: at 375 px the open Country filter list is clipped 64 px past the right edge (Tag 9 px).

Across all sessions there were no page errors, no console errors and no browser HTTP responses ≥400. The server log shows only 200/304/307/308 and no traceback, and there were zero external requests. The junk regex found no 'undefined', 'NaN', 'null' or '[object Object]'. It is worth noting that the Python token 'None' appears in the Minerals caveat, and the Insights Map empty state names a repo script path (scripts/build_city_gazetteer.py). Known items (plural rules, fmtNum grouping, '1 SÉRIES', '$14B') were not re-reported.

recheck.summary: I re-checked all nine of the walker's row-L items on my own fresh instance, and all nine are real on build 0deff9c4. Setup: a fresh data dir at /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/L-recheck/data (not copied), seeded with scripts/ui_clickthrough_seed.py (STATE C) plus a scratch copy of the row-L seed_extra.py, with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE=walk-pass-2026. Both .db files start with ciphertext bytes. The server ran on port 8959 with neither variable set; lock-state read 'locked' at boot and 'unlocked-encrypted' after every unlock through #pw / #btn-unlock. Airplane mode stayed on throughout, no request left loopback, and no page errors, console errors or HTTP >= 400 were recorded. The server was stopped by PID (20681). Each item was reproduced with my own Playwright scripts (r_*.py). Hovers were measured through the real #oo-tip bubble, not only the title attribute, and item 2 was also re-read after a reload in fr, which confirms it is stale content and not a missing translation. Two corrections to the walker. Item 9: while the Country list is open the document widens to 439 px and the page CAN be scrolled 64 px sideways (window.scrollX = 64), shifting the whole shell. The walker's hscroll of 0 was measured after the list was closed. Short entries also stay readable; only the longer labels lose their count. Item 1: the 'translated' law card it was compared with only has a translated title. Its type label, summary and caveat are English too. That is a wider class, so I added it as one new P2 item: every Home Lead card's type label, summary, method, ranking note and caveat stay English in fr/ar/zh, and only five producers have translatable titles. Two extra tokens are folded into existing items: '(1 flagged)' in the Law table (item 6), and the missing French space in 'Langues:' after a live switch (item 2).

Emit the summary as a keyed tf() frame (summary_i18n/summary_vars, mirroring title_i18n), with source names as data. Render the type label with t() over a keyed type-label map. items.root_cause: src/static/app.css:778-781: .msel .msel-list is position:absolute, anchored at its summary's left edge, with min-width:180px and no max-width or right anchoring. The phone media query (app.css around 1770-1800) makes the filter row wrap (the L4 fix) but has no override for the list, so a filter wrapped into the right column opens its list past the viewport.
items.suggested_fix: In the narrow media query, add .msel .msel-list { max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); } and anchor the list to the viewport. Options: right:0; left:auto for a .msel whose summary lies in the right half (a class set on toggle), or position:fixed; left:16px; right:16px under the open summary. Also let .msel-opt wrap (white-space:normal) so a long country name wraps instead of pushing out the count.
